channel.description: A log of research, learning, and whatever else I find interesting. Quantum metrology and quantum error correction.

item.title: All Weyl–Heisenberg SICs and ghosts in dimensions 4 to 7
item.description: Computer-aided proofs that the complexified Weyl–Heisenberg SIC equations have exactly 512, 4000, 6912 and 32928 solutions in dimensions 4 to 7. Half are SIC fiducials and, in these dimensions, the other half are ghosts. In dimensions 6 and 7 every solution has a Zauner symmetry of order 3, so the strong Zauner conjecture holds there.

item.title: SIC-POVMs in every dimension, formalized in Lean 4
item.description: A machine-checked Lean 4 proof that SIC-POVMs exist in every finite dimension, the existence part of Zauner's conjecture. It follows the proof of Radchenko and Wheeler, with a theorem of Appleby, Flammia and Kopp. Written by AI agents under human direction. Accepted by six kernels.
